cards.ex: She's a passionate environmental advocate, always speaking out against deforestation.
cards.exUz: U o'rmonlarning kesilishiga qarshi doimo gapiradigan, ishtiyoqli atrof-muhit himoyachisi.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitni himoya qilish uchun faoliyat olib boruvchi shaxs.

cards.ex: Overfishing continues to deplete fish stocks in many parts of the ocean.
cards.exUz: Haddan tashqari baliq ovlash okeanning ko'p qismlarida baliq zaxiralarini kamaytirishda davom etmoqda.

cards.ex: The company is keen to improve its green credentials by investing in solar power.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya quyosh energiyasiga sarmoya kiritib, o'zining ekologik ishonchini yaxshilashga intilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ekologik jihatdan mas'uliyatli ekanligini ko'rsatadigan dalillar.

cards.ex: Ultimately, taxpayers will foot the bill for cleaning up the contaminated site.
cards.exUz: Oxir oqibat, soliq to'lovchilar ifloslangan hududni tozalash xarajatlarini qoplaydilar.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni to'lash, xarajat uchun javobgar bo'lish.

cards.ex: Geothermal energy represents an untapped potential for clean power in this region.
cards.exUz: Geotermal energiya bu hududda toza energiya uchun foydalanilmagan imkoniyatni anglatadi.

cards.ex: If the negotiations fail, we'll be back to square one in our efforts to reduce emissions.
cards.exUz: Agar muzokaralar muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa, biz emissiyalarni kamaytirish bo'yicha harakatlarimizda boshiga qaytamiz.

cards.ex: The oil spill was an environmental catastrophe that devastated coastal ecosystems.
cards.exUz: Neftning to'kilishi qirg'oq ekotizimlariga zarar yetkazgan ekologik falokat edi.

cards.ex: We need sustainable solutions that address both economic and environmental concerns.
cards.exUz: Bizga ham iqtisodiy, ham ekologik muammolarni hal qiladigan barqaror yechimlar kerak.

cards.ex: New environmental regulations are on the horizon, so businesses need to prepare.
cards.exUz: Yangi ekologik qoidalar ufqda ko'rinmoqda, shuning uchun biznes tayyorlanishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yaqinda sodir bo'ladigan yoki keladigan narsa.

cards.ex: It's difficult, but not impossible, to reverse the damage caused by industrial pollution.
cards.exUz: Sanoat ifloslanishi natijasida yuzaga kelgan zararni bartaraf etish qiyin, lekin imkonsiz emas.
cards.uzDef: Yuzaga kelgan zararni qaytarish, oqibatlarini yo'qotish.

cards.ex: The extreme weather events were a wake-up call about the urgency of climate action.
cards.exUz: Favqulodda ob-havo hodisalari iqlim bo'yicha harakatlarning zarurligi haqida ogohlantiruvchi qo'ng'iroq edi.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy muammoga e'tiborni jalb qiladigan voqea.

cards.ex: We're all trying to minimize our environmental footprint by making more responsible choices.
cards.exUz: Biz hammamiz mas'uliyatli tanlovlar qilish orqali o'zimizning ekologik izimizni minimallashtirishga harakat qilmoqdamiz.

cards.ex: Sustainable agriculture practices can help protect soil health and reduce pollution.
cards.exUz: Barqaror qishloq xo'jaligi amaliyotlari tuproq sog'lig'ini himoya qilishga va ifloslanishni kamaytirishga yordam beradi.

cards.ex: Many communities are fighting against environmental injustice in their neighborhoods.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina jamoalar o'z mahallalarida ekologik adolatsizlikka qarshi kurashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kam ta'minlangan hududlarning ifloslanishdan ko'proq aziyat chekishi.

cards.ex: The new environmental policies are a breath of fresh air after years of inaction.
cards.exUz: Yangi ekologik siyosatlar ko'p yillik harakatsizlikdan so'ng toza havo kabi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi, yaxshi va o'zgarish olib keladigan narsa.

cards.ex: Habitat destruction continues to erode biodiversity at an alarming rate.
cards.exUz: Yashash muhitining yo'q qilinishi bioturlilikni dahshatli tezlikda yo'qotishda davom etmoqda.

cards.ex: We are at a crossroads in our efforts to address climate change; we must act decisively.
cards.exUz: Biz iqlim o'zgarishiga qarshi kurashdagi harakatlarimizda chorrahalardamiz; biz qat'iy harakat qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muhim qaror qabul qilish kerak bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: We can only hope that the drought will run its course soon.
cards.exUz: Biz faqat qurg'oqchilik tez orada o'z yo'lini o'tashiga umid qilishimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Tabiiy ravishda tugash, davom etish muddati tugash.

cards.ex: The government gave the green light to the construction of the new wind farm.
cards.exUz: Hukumat yangi shamol fermasining qurilishiga yashil chiroq yoqdi.

cards.ex: We must tread lightly on the Earth to protect its delicate ecosystems.
cards.exUz: Biz nozik ekotizimlarni himoya qilish uchun Yerda ehtiyotkorlik bilan harakat qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hech kimga zarar yetkazmaslik uchun ehtiyot bo'lish.

cards.ex: Eco-tourism can provide economic benefits to local communities while preserving the environment.
cards.exUz: Eko-turizm atrof-muhitni saqlab qolgan holda mahalliy jamiyatlarga iqtisodiy foyda keltirishi mumkin.

cards.ex: Some scientists believe we have already passed the point of no return with climate change.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi olimlarning fikricha, biz iqlim o'zgarishi bilan bog'liq qaytmas nuqtadan o'tib ketdik.

cards.ex: The government needs to tighten regulations on industrial emissions to protect public health.
cards.exUz: Hukumat jamoat salomatligini himoya qilish uchun sanoat chiqindilari bo'yicha qoidalarni qat'iylashtirishi kerak.

cards.ex: Climate change is threatening food security in many vulnerable regions.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi ko'pgina zaif hududlarda oziq-ovqat xavfsizligiga tahdid solmoqda.

cards.ex: Sustainable forestry practices ensure that forests are managed for future generations.
cards.exUz: Barqaror o'rmon xo'jaligi amaliyotlari o'rmonlarning kelajak avlodlar uchun boshqarilishini ta'minlaydi.

cards.ex: Developing countries often get a raw deal when it comes to environmental agreements.
cards.exUz: Rivojlanayotgan mamlakatlar ko'pincha ekologik kelishuvlarga kelsak, adolatli kelishuvga ega bo'lishmaydi.

cards.ex: The government plans to phase out coal-fired power plants over the next decade.
cards.exUz: Hukumat kelgusi o'n yillikda ko'mirda ishlaydigan elektr stantsiyalarini bosqichma-bosqich bekor qilishni rejalashtirmoqda.

cards.ex: Some companies are accused of greenwashing their products to attract environmentally conscious consumers.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi kompaniyalar ekologik ongli iste'molchilarni jalb qilish uchun o'z mahsulotlarini yashil bo'yashda ayblanmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ekologik ko'rinish berish, lekin aslida emas.

cards.ex: Wildlife conservation is crucial for maintaining biodiversity and healthy ecosystems.
cards.exUz: Yovvoyi tabiatni muhofaza qilish bioturlilikni va sog'lom ekotizimlarni saqlash uchun juda muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Yovvoyi hayvonlar va ularning yashash joylarini saqlash.

cards.ex: Marine debris poses a serious threat to marine life and ecosystems.
cards.exUz: Dengiz axlati dengiz hayoti va ekotizimlarga jiddiy tahdid soladi.
